title: A test file's name states its tier, and a check enforces it
context: Jest collected integration tests only from test/integration/**/*.itest.ts, so a file there named .test.ts was silently never run.
decision: Unit tests are *.test.ts under src/, integration tests *.itest.ts under test/integration/, and end-to-end tests *.e2e.ts under test/e2e/. A check fails on a test file whose suffix does not match its directory. Jest setup files live under test/setup/; only jest.config.ts stays at the repository root.

alternatives.option: Let the directory alone set the tier
alternatives.reason: The tier would no longer show in the file name, which search and review rely on.
